relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day channel, order and integration work.

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Reports, data and status flowing between parties.

relations.name: Sets channel targets for
relations.description: The owner decides which marketplaces to enter and sets margin and revenue targets the marketplace manager executes.

relations.name: Reports channel performance to
relations.description: Monthly revenue, buy box and margin per channel.

relations.name: Hands sold orders to
relations.description: Listings and prices generate orders that operations must ship within the marketplace promise.

relations.name: Feeds stock availability to
relations.description: Stock positions across own and marketplace warehouses decide which offers can stay live.

relations.name: Provides integrated data to
relations.description: IT connects ERP, PIM and webshop so catalogue, price and stock reach the hub.

relations.name: Keeps order and stock syncs running for
relations.description: IT monitors and repairs integration jobs that operations depends on.

relations.name: Supplies products and sets price floors for
relations.description: Brands sell to multichannel merchants that resell on marketplaces, and compete with them on their own direct offers.

relations.name: Sells WMS or shipping software with embedded marketplace connections to
relations.description: Partner platforms such as DeliveryMatch offer marketplace orders and shipment updates inside their own product.

relations.name: Pays for embedded connectivity to
relations.description: Merchants pay the partner, which sets its own price; the partner pays EffectConnect under an agreed partner model.

relations.name: Provides master content to
relations.description: Brand master data and images feed reseller and own listings.
